name: Octomon
main_effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] If there are 4 or more total Digimon, play 1 [Fujitsumon] Token suspended to your battle area. (Digimon/Purple/3000 DP/[All Turns] This Digimon doesn't unsuspend. [On Deletion] Trash 1 card in your hand.) If there are 3 or fewer, play it suspended to your opponent's battle area.
source_effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When an effect plays an opponent's Digimon, gain 1 memory.
